hypothesis.statement: Installing reconstruction repositories without checking hardware, immutable provenance and territory terms can produce unreproducible or unauthorized candidates.
hypothesis.action: Pin official repository revisions, require weight checksums and reviewed licenses, inspect host capabilities and block argv construction unless every model-specific requirement passes.
hypothesis.expectedResult: Only attributable, licensed runs on capable workers can enter the six-candidate benchmark.

trellis.officialMinimum: Linux, NVIDIA CUDA GPU, 24 GiB VRAM

hunyuan.territoryFinding: The official Hunyuan3D 2.x community license excludes South Korea and forbids use of its works and outputs outside the licensed Territory.

decision: Do not install or execute Hunyuan3D in South Korea. Run TRELLIS.2 only after an approved Linux/CUDA worker and exact weights checksum are available. The second-model requirement needs a legally usable replacement before generation begins.
